card.name: Just before a dose amount
card.fires_on: The spot right before a dose or schedule appears, such as an opening parenthesis after a drug name, the start of a dose number, or the q in q8h. Also partway through drug names like fluconazole and levothyroxine.

modes.label: Opening of a dose
modes.description: A parenthesis or first digit that begins a dose after an interacting drug name.

modes.label: Dosing interval letter
modes.description: The q in an every-so-many-hours schedule after mg/kg.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle or end pieces of drug names, mostly azole antifungals and thyroid drugs.

card.writes: It suppresses the word treatment in several languages, so it pushes away general treatment words where a dose or number is due.
card.plain: It fires where a drug name is about to be followed by its dose or dosing schedule.
